authority: examples/points.example.csv shows the exact column order; all core columns must remain. Extra columns are optional strings. Changes invalidate dependent stages.
row_rules: One coordinate-bearing row per resolved source instance. Unique point_id AND source_instance_id.
All coordinate-bearing CSV stages contain only policy-eligible CO2 series. Excluded series may be recorded as non-coordinate audit metadata but never as CSV rows.
All CSV rows require export_eligible=true and nonempty CO2 species evidence.

Agent 04 points.csv is the authoritative final marker inventory: its point IDs must equal Agent 03 IDs minus IDs explicitly listed with action=delete, plus Agent 04 additions. An omitted Agent 03 ID without an explicit delete is incomplete and must be corrected; the host makes one correction attempt and retains Agent 03 inventory for repair if omissions remain.

Agent 04 final CSVs are marker-only: use visible_marker, partially_visible_marker, estimated_marker, or reviewer_asserted_marker. Do not include line_sample, template, fit, reported_numeric, or manual rows.

reviewer_asserted_marker is for a new Agent 04 row whose ID does not match Agent 03, whose finite in-frame position and eligible CO2 series are valid, and whose notes have no native evidence citation. It requires is_inferred=false and confidence=low. It may remain accepted when the report verdict is accept; this evidence type alone does not require human review.

is_inferred=true only for line_sample, template_fill, and estimated_marker rows (series template placed on a crowded-strip slot between real markers of that series; estimated_marker is a point with no visible centre, placed from the series' ink, column, and trajectory); these rows always go to review. Other hypotheses stay in unresolved metadata.
estimated_marker rows require nonblank uncertainty_x and uncertainty_y, confidence=low, and marker_shape equal to the series' declared marker; they are never auto-accepted.

Native coordinates are finite and lie inside source plot. x/y calculated only with valid axes; otherwise blank. A configured mask overlap is retained as mask_warning metadata and notes, not silently dropped.
uncertainty_x/y optional, finite nonnegative, in reported data units; do not manufacture certainty.

Native reviewer evidence kind, item reference, source description, and raw uncertainty_px are retained in stage metadata and notes. uncertainty_x/y are the calibrated axis-unit projection of uncertainty_px when calibration is valid.
normalized_x/y optional. Populate only through documented conditional conversions, with conversion_id(s).
line_sample rows, when present in earlier diagnostic stages, require marker_shape=none, is_inferred=true, and confidence=low. Agent 04 final CSVs never include sampled trace ink.
